conditions.description: JEM Excavation replaces the former JEMCompat owner in every JEM distribution before the old handler is removed from a runtime pack. Existing enchanted ItemStacks retain the same registry ID and disabled-level NBT key.

change.summary: Focused standalone modules replace selected JEMCompat feature owners without changing established gameplay identities

modifiers.before: JEMCompat registers the enchantment, events, preview and mining Mixins
modifiers.after: JEM Excavation exclusively registers the same enchantment ID, events, preview and mining Mixins

modifiers.before: JEMExcavationDisabledLevel stores a temporarily disabled enchantment level
modifiers.after: JEMExcavationDisabledLevel stores a temporarily disabled enchantment level

modifiers.before: JEMCompat owns the client controller and camera integration Mixins
modifiers.after: JEM Freecam exclusively owns the same controller, key identity and camera integration Mixins

modifiers.before: JEMCompat owns day and season inventory presentation
modifiers.after: JEM Seasons HUD exclusively owns the same config keys, localization, textures and native calendar presentation

modifiers.before: JEMCompat owns the Delete key handler and jemcompat:inventory_delete channel
modifiers.after: JEM Inventory Shortcuts exclusively owns the same key behavior and jemcompat:inventory_delete protocol 1 channel

modifiers.before: Sub-minute duration labels may contain fractional seconds
modifiers.after: Every positive duration is ceiling-rounded to whole seconds before seconds or minutes presentation, while simulation and synchronization remain in ticks
Unofficial Luxium Compatibility public display name with stable jem_luxium technical ID and required upstream disclaimer

rationale.purpose: Make the approved feature independently installable without JEMCompat while preventing duplicate behavior in JEM distributions.
rationale.decision_source: User-approved public CurseForge standalone mod plan dated 2026-10-28.
rationale.user_requested: Prepare eleven independent Forge 1.20.1 projects and preserve established identities.
rationale.codex_choices: Retain the legacy enchantment namespace, item NBT, config keys, translations and network channel while moving each complete owner together.

history.summary: Move approved feature owners into independently buildable JEM modules, retain established technical identities, and prepare truthful public presentation without uploading projects.

relations: Existing enchanted tool -> unchanged jem_pack_core:excavation identity -> standalone mining owner
Native block admission -> server-owned batch mining -> native removal and durability callbacks
Delete key -> legacy protocol 1 request -> server validates one physical slot
Native time and optional season state -> standalone client HUD -> unchanged presentation
notes: Level I remains 3x3 and level II remains 7x7. The original block, tool, permission, removal, Unbreaking and preview code moved without gameplay-rule changes.
Freecam remains client-authoritative presentation only. Inventory deletion remains server validated and rejects unreviewed virtual slots.
unresolved: Existing enchanted-item migration and protected-block behavior require player runtime acceptance in an authorized clean instance.
